PATTERN: Next.js 15 app for outfit-to-buy-links pipeline
COMPONENTS:
- Upload outfit photo in UI
- Gemini Flash Vision (@google/generative-ai) identifies each item (type, color, brand, style)
- Next.js API routes proxy Vinted searches (server-side session cookie auth)
- Results shown with buy links
WHY: Gemini Vision > Claude Vision for visual fashion/item identification tasks
ARCH: All state in page.tsx, no over-engineering. Phase-based UI: upload → identified items → search results
VINTED AUTH: Fetch session cookie from vinted.lt homepage, cache it, proxy searches through API routes (no official Vinted API)
DEFAULT MARKET: vinted.lt (Lithuania)
NEEDS: GEMINI_API_KEY in .env.local (free tier: 15 RPM on Flash, enough for MVP)
